Statystyka obejmuje wyłącznie jawnie wyb: Statistics use only the selected compound group. SD measures variation across ROIs and SE(D) describes individual fit uncertainty. ROIs from one experiment may have correlated errors and should not be treated as independent replicates. SEM is descriptive and excludes some sources of uncertainty in D. Outliers are kept unless excluded by the user.
